description: Fix all audit findings from PRD compliance and code quality analysis (D1-D9 dimensions). Key findings: (1) Cache TTL values deviate from PRD specification - code uses 5min/10min instead of PRD-mandated 24h/7d/30d, (2) Server has no input validation on page/query params leading to potential TMDB errors, (3) VideoPlayer accepts messages from undocumented origin 'brightpathsignals.com', (4) Server cache eviction uses naive FIFO when hitting MAX_CACHE_SIZE - first entries are deleted regardless of recency, (5) Missing Content-Security-Policy connect-src for the actual backend API endpoint, (6) useMemo dependency issue in Home.jsx - heroItem recalculates on every render due to random selection pattern inside useMemo
steps: Step 1 - Fix Cache TTL mismatch (D9 HIGH): In apps/web/src/utils/cache.js, update TTL values to match PRD: CONTENT_LIST should be 86400 (24 hours), CONTENT_DETAIL should be 604800 (7 days), IMAGES should be 2592000 (30 days), SEARCH should be 3600 (1 hour). Add a comment referencing the PRD specification.

Step 2 - Fix server input validation (D3 MEDIUM): In apps/server/src/index.js, add validation for the 'page' query parameter - ensure it is a positive integer between 1 and 1000. For the search query, ensure it is not empty and has a reasonable max length (200 chars). Return 400 with descriptive error for invalid input.

Step 3 - Fix VideoPlayer origin validation (D6 MEDIUM): In apps/web/src/components/VideoPlayer.jsx, remove the undocumented 'brightpathsignals.com' origin from the allowlist. Only 'https://vaplayer.ru' should be accepted as a valid origin for player events.

Step 4 - Fix server cache eviction (D7 MEDIUM): In apps/server/src/index.js, replace the naive FIFO eviction in setCache() with a proper approach that deletes the oldest entries based on createdAt timestamp rather than insertion order.

Step 5 - Fix Home.jsx heroItem random selection (D7 LOW): In apps/web/src/app/Home.jsx, the heroItem useMemo uses Math.random() inside, making it non-deterministic between renders on the same data. Fix by using a stable selection approach - pick the first item or use a hash of the first item's id to select index deterministically.

Step 6 - Fix CSP connect-src (D6 MEDIUM): In apps/web/index.html, the Content-Security-Policy connect-src directive lists 'self' and 'https://vaplayer.ru' but the app makes requests to its own backend via relative URLs which is fine with 'self'. Verify no issues, but also add https://image.tmdb.org to img-src data: for any image loading edge cases. Actually the img-src already covers tmdb. Check if connect-src needs to allow the deployed API domain. Since the app uses relative '/api' paths (covered by 'self'), this is fine. SKIP this step - no fix needed.

Step 7 - Add missing staleTime to React Query (D7 MEDIUM): In apps/web/src/App.jsx, the QueryClient has staleTime: 0 which means React Query will always refetch on mount even if data exists in its cache. Since we already have a CacheManager with proper TTLs, set staleTime to 60000 (1 minute) to reduce unnecessary duplicate requests and align with caching strategy.
acceptance_criteria: Cache TTL values in apps/web/src/utils/cache.js match PRD: 86400s for lists, 604800s for details, 2592000s for images, 3600s for search
Server validates page parameter is 1-1000 and returns 400 for invalid values
Server validates search query is non-empty and max 200 chars
VideoPlayer only accepts messages from https://vaplayer.ru origin
Server cache eviction removes oldest entries by createdAt
Home.jsx heroItem selection is deterministic for the same input data
QueryClient staleTime is set to a reasonable non-zero value
All verification commands (lint, typecheck, build, test) still pass after changes
